name: Gap Calculator
description: Select two objects in the editor and get the gap between them plus the minimum and recommended TPS to get through it.

gamemode.name: Gamemode
gamemode.description: Sets the default hitbox size. Wave also gets a fixed vertical speed (equal to portal speed, doubled when mini). Other modes use the portal speed on vertical gaps unless you set a custom speed.

mini.name: Mini size
mini.description: Use the mini hitbox for the chosen gamemode.

custom-hitbox.name: Custom hitbox size (units)
custom-hitbox.description: Overrides the gamemode hitbox when greater than 0.

speed.name: Speed portal
speed.description: Speed the player travels at along the gap axis.

custom-speed.name: Custom speed (units/sec)
custom-speed.description: Overrides the speed portal above when greater than 0. Useful for vertical gaps (ship, UFO, ball, etc.).

axis.name: Gap axis
axis.description: Auto uses the horizontal gap if there is one, otherwise the vertical gap.

ticks.name: Safety ticks inside gap
ticks.description: Recommended TPS guarantees at least this many physics ticks inside the gap.

button-offset-x.name: Button offset X
button-offset-x.description: Nudges the Gap button horizontally from its default spot next to the color picker (editor units).

button-offset-y.name: Button offset Y
button-offset-y.description: Nudges the Gap button vertically from its default spot (editor units).
